name: Saitou Hajime
source:
Captain of the Shinsen-gumi Third Corps. He has a keen eye and quick judgment. Nobody in the Shinsen-gumi knows why he covers one of his eyes. He is so skilled with a sword that even Hijikata and Okita acknowledge his superiority.

[Taken from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
